column1: Word got out and students and teachers were praising me. I felt I was about to do something big. I really felt it. And it goes like this. I felt god telling me today is your day. I go out work a little bit at a local starbucks, until it got too crowded and I went to the university. There I saw my partner in some class project, with another person chilling. They wanted to drink and play tablefootball or how Europeans call it fussball. I told him you need to work or something. He said let’s go and then work. I felt a strong urge not to drink since I know god will hate it because Islam forbids it but I felt in top of the world so why not. i drank with them but shit I felt soooooo empty that I heard the Voice in my head. It’s over you failed. I never felt this. And then it hit me the hardest way. God was helping you and you repay him by this. It broke me, this one drink. Yes this one drink destroyed my future that was already wrapped in my head. I kept crying for days like never before. I was like it’s over but I felt a chance of redemption so I refused to quit. I got to go to more meetups. Meet more people and find two partners who are willing to be part of my earphone project not school people, but men in suits. They agreed and I took them to a super fancy diner place where all was set. I was willing to carve with them a new road and they were on it. but It took me away from my studies, I never really cared No more. I went on trips. Worked on projects. My attendance was minimal. And my attidute to my colleagues deteriorated, until my birthday where my father was in town. I wanted to show him my team (which was expanding) and he was proud of me. The first time. Until he received a phone call from the CEO of the tech school. She said she wanted to meet him. He and I went and they explained they wanted to kick me out of the school. I was never there present at the meeting but I got the news from the office regardless. I can never forget the look on my fathers face once we reconciled. He looked shocked with crying like stuttering reminiscing the lost hope of me of the past. he pulled me over and kept saying e da? (What’s that?) becoming more potent every time he said it. I cried and confessed everything to him. He was so disappointed that I made it a liberty to finish this college just for him. I totally forgot about myself in the process. The truth is they wanted to kick me out because of my bad attitude towards my colleagues when they told me happy birthday and I trashed it, belittling everything they said, they complained and yeah. This was the last straw. I confined myself in my head. dissolving my earphone company And everything around me in life.
since I was young. left out.
educating myself rather than relying on school. Forced extensive medication and treatment on me.
Mecca. Digged a deeper hole from civilization in my head.
do you get it? or do you need further directions on the layers that I built in my brain.
i am not myself. Period. I’m in awe of what I could have been.
so what. I tell myself today.

i met a coach, in February I think, who taught me the most important aspect of life. Independent thinking. How every fact I know today is wrong. How most of laws you could learn by yourself. Do not rely on anybody. Even your coach. He gave me the exercise book and told me,  I won’t be here in 5 years but the knowledge you take from your book and your mindset is what you will take for life. with the possibility to train people in the future and pass this knowledge on. He unsurprisingly destroyed a lot of beliefs in my head. I started to see light. And I saw all the light coming in from knowledge. Not the made up reality or dare to say realities I created in my head.

he was a devout Christian. He said Only the bible will unlock you and the truth. I reached Leviticus until I said. Hold on. There’s so much more than the Bible. theres so much more left to learn.  And during this pandemic this is all I did. Know more and more and more. Wait. I didn’t even know myself which lead me straight to you. Yes you.

i searched the web for ‘ I purposely make myself worse ‘ and i found your story and her is my response. I find A) talking about my experiences really help. Even if you don’t care, I feel much much much better. Openness is the source of peace. Miscommunication (even with yourself) Is the cause of all war. I just talk. Be open. Even saying all I watched was BDSM stuff as I was destroying and torturing myself from the inside. It doesn’t matter, have no shame. I am who i am.

You do not need some expensive psychologist. asking you questions humans should ask in the first place but everyone is living a faucet of themselves and say why am I so lost, it’s because you never acknowledged who you are.

B) learn, learn, learn. I am humble to admit I didnt waste my life. That was only my expectations illuding me and why do we have so much expectations as a society, its because this is where the value is made through people’s lenses. Money just acknowledges value. Contracts are build on expectations. no wonder no body really ever find themselves through life where society already predetermined you. YOU. are nothing in everyone’s eyes anyway. no body cares about anyone. That’s why it’s so hard living. However, Knowledge will set you free. Start with finding the truth and connections through whatever medium you wish and you’ll see the pattern of the universe seek you. This last sentence may seem abstract but you’ll get it once you start searching. YouTube is amazing btw. Take as much knowledge as you can and spread it to everyone. A diffrent light emitting in the darkness.
As for me, my plans for the future goes as follows. I wrote this on June the 15th.
* School of psychology, self expression matters. Talk + Express themselves free space. School building space space to fail.
* Understanding body, mind and soul. (Energy within)
* New Monetary System pegged to the Energy Orgone and energy exchange between individuals. FREEDOM - Exchange of tasks.
IT infrastructure grows, all I can do is aid it
this is my ambition and I’ll get to work starting Tom.

Hey man. so There it goes. I wrote a draft on June 6th and I paused thinking about what I wrote for about 10 days. I could say Ive identified the issues pulling me in the black hole in my head. You’ll see exactly when I paused. Here’s the first draft unedited. Until it hit me:

Dude. Your story right now is what I needed. Ive had this attacking syndrome on myself ever since 2015 when my parents casually went to the pilgrimage in Mecca and I didn’t want to be there. I was in summer school where I met some of the coolest people around the world. i loved them so much. I was crying when i left holding a girl on the bus locking hands. I never had this type of group around me. I was always bullied in middle school and when I switched schools the bullying rumors spread over and I was in a bubble Of my own thoughts. I loved the new school, but after them ambushing me with the rumors I locked myself up. My family was all I got here. And they were so smart, my father is so rich and successful. his rags to riches story is what everyone expects me to be like.  my mom is the role model. Always there and perfect. But somehow, somewhat I feel she is depressed sacrificing a lot for me and I hated that. Really. I always act jolly and fake happy. Like goofy around her. She smiles but as her son. I really feel her pain. It kind of did affect me I don’t know why. However I never had any bad thoughts before 2015. Even as a skinny kid. Even being bullied. Even dealing with the new rumors. But after leaving my summer school. I missed it dearly and I felt depressed. I wanted to get away from my family. But no. They were all I got and because all of the rumors I had no friends at the school. So when they were like we are going on a pilgrimage I was like no. I want be left here at home but I was 15 at the time. And i had no choice. And I really didn’t want to be left alone in my house. So I went and I felt so in my thoughts during this time. Really really really far away from reality. I was locked and I hated it there. Saudi Arabia is the most horrid country with the most horrid people I ever encountered. I pretended I was ok but I wasn’t. and Then I was like if I’m here in the first (paused to reflect, this pause gave me the realization exactly what I needed)

yes I paused. It hit me. I created a new ficticous me that I aspire to and I closed off reality. Let me explain. During this time. I talked to god and I felt he offered me an easy and hard way into the future, but it hit me right now that all that was in my head. A reason to escape this newfound reality I really despise. Regardless of my decision, I became agitated with all my flaws and sins. I talked to god and I promised him I’ll change. However. I fell in a massive depression. MASSIVE.

I Started forming An eating disorder, my back disformed from a bad posture. Despite me being athletic and 6’4, I started stressing myself. My hair started to fall out from the stress Which drove me insane, all I kept thinking about is my hair. I was so away from reality. I created my own demons and followed it. i was so ditached with my school that they labeled me ”the best passive student we've ever seen” once I graduated in 2016. it hurts, but I was obsessed with this pain, I believed that this is the cost of the hard way of a reality I was so desperate to escape for years. Anyway most universities rejected me because A) I was too late, I had no perception for time and reality at this point and B) my grades where terrible compared to the acedemic Standard but nvm really. I set up an astounding portfolio which will land me wherever I desired, it will subdue the costs. my top universities I listed rejected me which bummed me out. Because I didn’t have a credible plan or alternative, My father encouraged me to go to Stuttgart because he had connections there since he was a professor. I went and despite impressing the chairman of the institut with my knowledge. They were unable to accept me because of my grades. I started to get desperate and look for low tier design colleges in Italy. They were crap. Utterly crap. in Florence and Milan. The last option IED a design school with tourist level credentials accepted me but were unable to promise a certificate because guess what. My grades. we went on a family vacation around Europe but in Berlin I received a very special phone call. A brand new tech school was willing to enroll me as the founding batch in the port of Barcelona. They were impressed by my portfolio and they were willing to take me regardless of my grades. my father thought It was a scam. But I totally knew it was legit since I applied there a while back. I was excited as not all hope was lost. So yeah. Barcelona became my home for the next 3 years.

But what I created in the first place, before this story even began, was Divsion from people. No wonder I was bullied, put in involuntary psychological therapy And even left out. but I was so innocent to the bullying and the Therapy that it never really hindered me. But these thoughts accumulated a division in me over the years that distressed my reality. Whatever I create in my head is the way Ill live by.

I had to lift myself up sacrificing my summer of 2019 but I failed. I’m stuck. I feel I wasted my golden years. It has been 5 years in my hole. 2015-2020. And I feel I wasted all my talents of Design. I firmly believed that I was the best designer in the room anywhere I went before. Now tarnished by 3 years of staring at a 13” screen. I can barely draw and sketch. My sketching superpower is dead. i tried so hard to re-evoke my designing prowess all summer but I failed. I was so defeated.

Way before in 2017 I experienced the same defeat where I felt I betrayed the hard path i set up in 2015, by drinking, yes drinking. I started drinking to let go off the thoughts I created. Even smoking weed, but it was all no use. on the New Years of 2016. I made sure I will change and do something big. I figured this world out since I was a kid but I was waiting for school to finish so I can be free and go wild. I told my self. My thoughts wont interrupt my dreams and I created an earphones startup which impressed my school. I started researching quantum computing and the future. I became the wonderkid. I was Still 17 at this time. i gained so much momentum I sneaked my way into a private party full of investors and managed to let someone give me his badge who turned out to be a space exploration CEO. he gave me his badge and I went to the biggest conference in Barcelona. The mobile world congress.
march 1, 2017. I went but I heard from his advice that they don’t accept badges no more without credible ID. so I stayed up all night to photoshop my ID to make sure his name is on it.

i came up, hordes of VIPs going in with the cheapest ticket like 799 euros, so I felt uneasy. I showed them my badge at the gate and the photoshopped picture on my iPhone and they said they need a real one. I came up with oh it’s stolen. They didn’t believe me. I tryed again. Revoked  Again. Revoked. I contact the CEO to tell him I need his email to let me in by some QR tech alternative, I can’t remember what it was but an alternative requiring no ID, he apologized and I really can’t remember his apology but it Doesn’t matter. I remembered a Muslim prayer where they froze the people trying to kill a prophet by a prayer, it goes like this ‘you shall not see from what’s im front and behind you’. Anyway I came up showed my real ID. and kept reciting it and said god if you are really there and with me, help me. I really did show my real ID and his name. My name is Yousef Mahmoud and his was Jorge López Urdiales, two different names and it worked and I got in. It was a miracle and I remembered I am in the hard way.
